title: Ren-2019-redaction-10.1016/j.clinph.2019.03.028
description: An example intracranial EEG recording from one patient under intracranial monitoring, distributed with the code accompanying Ren, Gliske, Brang and Stacey (2019). It contains 61 channels sampled at 5000 Hz for 10 minutes, along with 357 automated qHFO (quantitative high-frequency oscillation) detections. The data demonstrate a wavelet-entropy feature that separates EMG-contaminated false HFOs from true HFOs in epilepsy.
methods_description: The recording is a 61-channel intracranial EEG matrix (3,000,001 samples at 5000 Hz) converted from MATLAB int16 to BrainVision float32 with values unchanged. The qHFO detections (start/stop sample and channel) were converted to events.tsv. Channel names, electrode positions, reference and units were not released.
